short: Multi-view input (M05) and LPC/LSP regression (M06) are standard: both precede it; view gain shrinks to +2-6% on held-out speakers. Evaluation (M12) is behind: PESQ and a 4-way phrase choice.
position: The paper [@kumar2019lipper] changes the camera input (M05), up to five OuluVS2 views chosen by a pose classifier, and the regressor (M06), a spatio-temporal CNN with BiGRU predicting LPC/LSP features. Both are standard: multi-view speech reconstruction on OuluVS2 appears in the authors' 2018 system [@kumar2018harnessing] [concurrent], and the LPC/LSP target is the Vid2speech route [@ephrat2017vid2speech]. The evaluation (M12) is behind: PESQ plus a four-alternative phrase choice, where four earlier systems measured intelligibility directly. The best view combination is chosen on the speaker-dependent test results it is reported on, and on two held-out speakers the three-view gain over frontal falls from +15.6% to +2.1% and +5.7% PESQ (Tables 4, 6, 10; inference). The conclusion's real-time and speaker-independence claims are unsupported.
